history.summary: Important Durga shrine at Kalishashon, ~6 km from Kailashahar (Unakoti district), per the Unakoti district website; dedicated to Goddess Bhabatarini, an avatar of Durga, with a Shiva idol also reported on site. Traditional stone temple with garbhagriha, torana gateway and pillared courtyard. CSV town 'Sabroom' is WRONG — corrected to Kalishashon (near Kailashahar), Unakoti; the CSV state Tripura is right. IDENTITY CAVEAT: a separate 'Bhabatarini Mondir' exists near Kumarghat (mapcarta/POI at 24.16181, 92.04282); if the CSV compiler meant that shrine, this file needs revision. Coordinates are town-level (Kailashahar) and approximate — exact village position not published; no dedicated temple history or build date found in sources.

name: Maa Bhabatarini Temple
town_description: Kailashahar is the headquarters of Unakoti district in northern Tripura, a municipal town on the banks of the Manu river near the Bangladesh border; its name combines 'Hara' (Shiva) with 'Kailasha', Shiva's abode. It is the gateway to the Unakoti rock-cut archaeological site and the Maa Bhabatarini mandir at nearby Kalishashon.

travel.airport: Maharaja Bir Bikram Airport, Agartala (~178 km from Kailashahar by road)
travel.railway: Kumarghat Junction (26 km from Kailashahar); buses/autos to Kailashahar
travel.road: Kalishashon is ~6 km from Kailashahar; Kailashahar is connected by bus to Guwahati, Silchar, Shillong and Agartala

visitor_information.best_time: October–March, the cooler dry season; the annual Maa Bhabatarini Mela is the busiest period
visitor_information.opening_hours: 6 AM–10 PM (per travel listings; verify locally)
